separateSourceTranslationFindings.issue: She is made the speaker. The governing source subject is the eunuchs ordered to flatter the crown prince in s0015; 每見…輒歎 continues those flatterers. Correct paired translations require independent editorial review.
Himself butchering/selling contradicts 使人屠酤 (he had others butcher and sell). The source weighing refers to weights of goods, while idiomatic adds weighing coin.
Double stipends loses 探取二月, drawing two months in advance; the source describes an advance, not a permanent doubling.
Prince Chengdu of Ying garbles 成都王穎. Ying is the prince’s given name and Chengdu is the principality. Existing person ownership remains p040.
He feared drunken copying invents copying in a sentence about not yet seeing 殿下 and fear of becoming intoxicated. Literal retains the distinct sense.
Lü jailed and starved Yu wrongly gives Liu Zhen’s actions to Lü. Source 慮以告劉振，振乃徙太子…絕不與食 explicitly makes Zhen the jailer/starver. Existing Chinese links and claims retain correct person identities.
Repent posthumously changes Jia’s claimed earlier hope that Yu would repent while alive into postmortem repentance. No ownership correction can fix this source translation.

千秋 is rendered autumn-thousand years, obscuring the personal-name allusion. The complete 壺關幹主，千秋悟己 passage requires independent philological/editorial review and potentially additional extraction coverage; no new person or claim has been invented in this candidate.
